es.name: Berni

es.bio: Dirige CBO Salud y coordina el trabajo entre sus áreas. En Consulta Dietista, te acompaña con propuestas de alimentación flexibles y seguimiento para ayudarte a construir hábitos que puedas mantener.

en.name: Berni
en.role: Founder & Director of CBO Salud · Dietitian Consultation
en.credentials: Graduate in Physical Activity and Sport Sciences and Higher Technician in Dietetics.
en.bio: Leads CBO Salud and coordinates the work across its areas. In Dietitian Consultation, you get flexible nutrition plans and follow-up to help you build habits you can keep.

es.name: Itziar
es.role: Responsable de Entrenamiento Personal · Entrenamiento y readaptación
es.credentials: Graduada en Ciencias de la Actividad Física y del Deporte.

en.name: Itziar
en.role: Head of Personal Training · Training & rehabilitation
en.credentials: Graduate in Physical Activity and Sport Sciences.
en.bio: Coordinates the personal training area and works with you in your sessions, focusing on strength, movement and exercise progression, adapting the plan to your starting point.

es.name: Guillermo

en.name: Guillermo
en.credentials: Graduate in Physiotherapy and in Physical Activity and Sport Sciences. Reg. no. 2342.
en.bio: Coordinates the physiotherapy area and looks after your recovery needs, combining physiotherapy and physical activity training to address aches and injuries in relation to your everyday and sporting activities.

en.name: Alba
en.role: Head of Reformer Pilates · Personal Training
en.credentials: Higher Technician in Physical Activity and Sports Animation.
en.bio: Coordinates the Reformer Pilates area and works in personal training, guiding you through the exercises, adjusting the difficulty and keeping movement control throughout the sessions.

es.name: Guti
es.credentials: Graduado en Ciencias de la Actividad Física y del Deporte.
es.bio: Te acompaña en el entrenamiento con una planificación adaptada a tus objetivos. Supervisa la técnica y ajusta los ejercicios y las cargas para que avances de forma progresiva.

en.name: Guti
en.credentials: Graduate in Physical Activity and Sport Sciences.
en.bio: Supports your training with a plan adapted to your goals, checking your technique and adjusting exercises and loads so you progress steadily.

en.name: Marina

es.name: Manu

en.name: Manu
en.credentials: Higher Technician in Physical Activity and Sports Animation.
en.bio: Guides you through your training sessions, adapting the exercises to your level and needs, with a focus on supporting you, caring for your execution and helping you stay consistent.

en.name: Imanol
en.credentials: Graduate in Physical Activity and Sport Sciences.

en.name: Dani
